card.name: Poor and ultra-rapid metabolizer phrases
card.fires_on: The word poor (often the 'or' in 'po-or') and the following parts of 'metabolizers' in CYP2D6 genotype descriptions. Also fires on 'rapid' in 'ultra-rapid metabolizers'.
